0022600200.text: The Bucks (1-8, 15th in the East, 5.5 games back in the Central) host the Celtics (7-2) on a five-game losing streak for Milwaukee. Milwaukee is 1-4 at home and 0-4 on the road, while Boston is 5-0 at home, sits second in the East and the Atlantic, and is riding a two-game winning streak. Boston beat the Bucks 109-102 in Boston on November 4, leaving Milwaukee trailing 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after losing 1-3 to the Celtics in 2025-26.
